articles.title: Bitget Hacker Turns to Zcash Privacy Pool After Near Rejects $50M in Swaps
articles.snippet: The attacker behind the $387.5 million Bitget heist has started hiding about $3.8 million in ZEC inside Zcash's Ironwood pool, after Near Intents turned their swaps away.

articles.title: Coinbase Now Owns Every Layer of Its Derivatives Stack After CFTC Approval
articles.snippet: Coinbase Clearing will take USDC as collateral and settle around the clock, though margined products stay with partners.

articles.title: A Clever RSA Attack Fooled a Hardware Vault—Here's What It Means for Crypto
articles.snippet: A UC San Diego-led team impersonated a hardware security module without extracting its key.
